# Handle special data types <a href="#handle-special-data-types" id="handle-special-data-types"></a>

Some data needs handling beyond n8n's standard JSON structure, such as binary files, dates, and nested JSON.

## In this section

* [Work with files and images](work-with-files-and-images.md): understand and use binary data in n8n.
* [Work with dates and times](work-with-dates-and-times.md): use Luxon to work with date and time in n8n.
* [Query JSON data](query-json-data.md): use JMESPath to simplify working with JSON formatted data.
